answer: Every claim waits on a ledge while it is whispered across the network: the filer sends a sealed note to ten random workers, each forwards it once, and its fingerprint reaches a hundred hands in a day. If the same work is filed twice, the whispers meet and the Lotus desk freezes both claims; each claim locks a 150-coin bond, forfeited on a duplicate, so 1,000 copies burn 150,000 coins. One operator filed one report under forty names, but the whispers crossed within hours and the desk froze every copy.
